report:
# TokiGo — Phase 1 visual audit: booking funnel + Bag/Trip surfaces

**Scope:** `lib/features/booking/presentation/pages/**` (checkout_page.dart 844, passenger_details_page.dart 815, booking_confirmation_page.dart 603, hotel_guest_details_page.dart 160, add_ons_page.dart 108), `lib/features/bag/presentation/pages/**` (bag_page.dart 424, trip_details_page.dart 374), `lib/features/bag/presentation/trip_labels.dart`. Audit only — no files changed.
**Lens:** M3 (`material-design-3-ui`). Contrast ratios are computed from the real token values in `core/theme/*` (WCAG relative luminance); AA = 4.5:1 text, 3:1 non-text/graphics.
**Verdict:** the monochrome foundation, 8dp rhythm, radius scale and card recipe are largely coherent; the gaps are (1) a light-only `textTertiary` AA failure, (2) several dark-mode text colours that are never overridden, (3) status chips that bypass the AA-safe `StatusChip.forTone`, (4) a CTA-bar split (blurred light variant in the funnel vs charcoal on detail pages), and (5) a proposed red primary that currently fails AA with the app's 17/600 button label.

## A. Cross-cutting theme findings (repeat on every page — fix first)

- `lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart:57-84` (light) and `:231-258` (dark) — `ColorScheme.primary` is `ink.brand` (#111111 / #F5F5F5); the proposed red #E53935 is not mapped to any M3 role, so no primary CTA/FAB/selected state resolves to it today. — **color** — **high** — map `primary`/`onPrimary` to the red pair and `primaryContainer` to a tonal step; keep `secondary`/`tertiary` neutral. White on #E53935 measures **4.23:1** (fails AA at `AppButton`'s 17/600 label), black on #E53935 measures **4.97:1** (passes) → use black `onPrimary`, or darken to #D32F2F (white 4.98:1).
- `lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart:190` (`textTertiary` #8E8E8E) — **3.14:1** on `background` #FAFAFA and **3.28:1** on `surface` #FFFFFF → fails AA for the 13px `caption` / 15px `body` text that use it (page-header subtitles, card subtitles, references, fact labels). Dark passes (6.41 / 5.72). — **accessibility/light-dark** — **high** — darken the light `textTertiary` to ≥4.5:1 (e.g. #6B6B6B ≈ 4.9:1 on #FAFAFA) or reserve it for ≥18px display type only.
- `lib/core/widgets/sticky_cta_bar.dart:66-80` — the default `light` variant is a `BackdropFilter` blur (sigma 16) over 90% `surface`; the new "no excessive blur" rule and the stated charcoal bar both conflict with it. — **component/color** — **high** — make the charcoal `dark` variant the single funnel bar, or replace the blur with a solid surface + `hairlineStrong` top edge.
- `lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart:99` (`danger` #E11D48) vs the proposed primary #E53935 vs `brandRed` #FF2D2D (`:114`) — three reds; destructive (cancel / remove traveller / payment failure / cancelled status) and the new primary become confusable. — **color** — **high** — keep destructive on `danger`, give primary a clearly separated red, keep `brandRed` wordmark-only, and check the pairs are distinguishable at a glance.
- `lib/core/widgets/step_progress.dart:84` + `:157` — `StatusChip`'s default container is `color@10%` and its label is the 11px `label` style; the light status pairs measure success **2.96:1**, warning **2.86:1**, danger **4.00:1** → all fail AA. The AA-safe `StatusChip.forTone` (`:93-120`) exists and is not used by the Bag. — **accessibility** — **high** — route Bag/Trip status chips through `forTone` (or an `onContainer` label colour).
- `lib/core/ui/app_button.dart:112-115` — disabled primary/destructive foreground is `textTertiary` (#8E8E8E) on `surfaceTertiary` (#EFEFEF) = **3.32:1**, and the disabled fill is 1.15:1 from the bar → the disabled CTA fails AA and barely reads as a surface. — **accessibility/state** — **med** — use a disabled pair that clears 4.5:1 for the label (e.g. #757575 on #E4E4E4).
- `lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart:146` (`outline` #DBDBDB) — **1.38:1** on white; the audited cards separate from the canvas (#FFFFFF on #FAFAFA = 1.05:1) almost entirely through this border, so the surface edge fails non-text AA and reads faint. — **color/accessibility** — **med** — deepen component-boundary borders to ≥3:1, or apply the stated two-stop ink halo so the surface lifts without leaning on the hairline.
- `lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart:73-78` / `:247-252` — only `surface` and `surfaceContainerHighest` are mapped; `surfaceContainer`/`High`/`Low`/`Lowest` fall back to `surface` (`color_scheme.dart:1061`), so M3 components that read `surfaceContainer` get a flat surface instead of the container ramp. — **color/token** — **low** — map the four container roles explicitly (#FFFFFF/#F5F5F5/#EFEFEF light; #121212/#1E1E1E/#262626 dark).
- `lib/core/theme/app_typography.dart:37-44` — the ladder (36/28/25/22/17/15/13/11) is an editorial scale, not the M3 scale (displayLarge 57 / headlineLarge 32 / titleLarge 22 / bodyLarge 16 / labelLarge 14); the pages also mix `title` (25) and `bodyLargeMedium` (17) for the same section-heading role. — **typography** — **med** — adopt the M3 scale or record the editorial ladder as a deliberate departure, and use one section-heading token across the funnel.

## B. hotel_guest_details_page.dart (160) — largest deviation from the design system

- `hotel_guest_details_page.dart:81` and `:116` — `AppBar(title: Text('Guest details'))` with hardcoded English; no `AppPageHeader`, no `StepProgress`, no back fallback, no localized copy. — **component/state** — **high** — replace with `AppPageHeader(subtitle: l10n…, steps: StepProgress(current: 2, total: 4))` and localize the title.
- `hotel_guest_details_page.dart:103` and `:151` — `ElevatedButton` (M3 defaults: ~20px radius, `secondaryContainer` fill, no haptics) instead of the app's `AppButton` (52dp / radius 14 / brand fill / press feedback), and it scrolls inline instead of sitting in a pinned bar. — **component** — **high** — use `AppButton` inside a `StickyCtaBar`, matching passenger/add-ons/checkout.
- `hotel_guest_details_page.dart:126-148` — fields use floating `labelText` + hardcoded English ('Adult 1 name', 'Required'); the funnel already has two other recipes (passenger: external localized label; checkout: floating label). — **component/accessibility** — **high** — adopt one field recipe (external `AppTypography.label` + `TextField`, as passenger does) and localize the labels/errors.
- `hotel_guest_details_page.dart:124-148` — fields sit directly on the canvas with `bottom: AppSpacing.sm` (8) and no card container, while passenger wraps the same kind of form in a white `surface` card with 12dp rhythm. — **spacing/component** — **med** — wrap each room in a surface card with `all(lg)` padding and a 12dp field rhythm.
- `hotel_guest_details_page.dart:92` and `:98` — `Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium/bodyMedium` instead of `AppTypography` tokens. — **typography** — **med** — use `typography.titleMedium` / `typography.body` so the empty state matches the rest of the app.
- `hotel_guest_details_page.dart:79-112` — hand-rolled empty state (Icon 44 + Text + ElevatedButton) instead of `AppMessageState`, which every other surface uses. — **component** — **med** — use `AppMessageState` for the no-rooms state.
- `hotel_guest_details_page.dart:117-158` — no `SafeArea`; the inline Continue button can end up under the gesture navigation bar. — **accessibility/spacing** — **med** — wrap in `SafeArea`/`StickyCtaBar` (which reads `viewPadding`).
- `hotel_guest_details_page.dart:88` — `Icon(Icons.hotel_outlined, size: 44, color: tc.textTertiary)` renders at 3.14:1 in light, below the 3:1 graphics guideline. — **accessibility** — **low** — use `textSecondary` for the empty-state glyph.

## C. passenger_details_page.dart (815)

- `passenger_details_page.dart:562-573` (label at `:566`) — `Text(label, style: typography.label)` uses `AppTypography.forLight()`'s `#737373` with no override → **3.96:1** on the dark `surface` #121212, failing AA for the 11px field labels. — **accessibility/light-dark** — **high** — `.copyWith(color: context.tokigoColors.textSecondary)`.
- `passenger_details_page.dart:600-622` (hint at `:615`) — `Text(l10n.bookingRequiredField, style: typography.body)` is `#262626` on the filled `#1E1E1E` field in dark → **~1.1:1**; the dropdown hint is effectively invisible. — **accessibility/light-dark** — **high** — override with `textSecondary`, and use a neutral prompt rather than "Required".
- `passenger_details_page.dart:568-573` — the `TextField` has no `labelText`; the visible label is a sibling `Text`, so the field exposes no accessible name (screen readers announce an unlabeled box). — **accessibility** — **high** — set `decoration.labelText` or bind the visible label with `Semantics(label:)`.
- `passenger_details_page.dart:190-195` — the section heading uses `typography.title` (25/700) while checkout uses `bodyLargeMedium` (17/600) for the same role → the funnel's heading scale is inconsistent. — **typography** — **med** — pick one section-heading token for all funnel pages.
- `passenger_details_page.dart:336-347` — the remove-traveller icon is painted in `danger` (#E11D48), which will collide with the proposed primary red. — **color** — **med** — keep destructive on `danger` and give it a distinct container treatment once primary is red.
- `passenger_details_page.dart:211` — default `light` `StickyCtaBar` (blur 16) instead of the charcoal component (see A). — **component/color** — **high** — use the charcoal variant.
- `passenger_details_page.dart:238-242` — the bar CTA is `AppButton` primary (brand fill); it is not the inverted white button the stated foundation describes. — **component/color** — **high** — decide the bar button treatment explicitly (see A, red-primary note).
- `passenger_details_page.dart:203` — bottom spacer `140` vs checkout's `160`; both are magic numbers off the 8dp scale. — **spacing** — **low** — use one shared "clear the CTA bar" token.
- `passenger_details_page.dart:615` — the empty dropdown's hint is the required-field message, which reads as an error before the user has typed anything. — **state** — **low** — neutral prompt by default; reserve "Required" for the error state.

## D. checkout_page.dart (844)

- `checkout_page.dart:508` — default `light` `StickyCtaBar` (BackdropFilter blur) instead of the charcoal bar used by offer details/city. — **component/color** — **high** — use `StickyCtaBarVariant.dark` (or a solid, blur-free light bar).
- `checkout_page.dart:533-540` — the bar's primary button is `AppButton` primary (brand fill): #111111 on a near-white bar in light, not the stated inverted white button on charcoal. — **component/color** — **high** — align the bar button with the foundation; if it stays inverted-white, decide explicitly that the bar CTA is exempt from the red primary.
- `checkout_page.dart:536` vs `:522` — the button label uses `toStringAsFixed(0)` ("Pay USD 300") while the bar total above it uses `toStringAsFixed(2)` ("USD 300.00") → two different renderings of the same amount on one screen. — **component/state** — **high** — one formatter (2 decimals) for both.
- `checkout_page.dart:611-615` — the selected payment radio's check is `Colors.white` on a `brand` circle; in dark `brand` is #F5F5F5 → **1.09:1**, the check disappears. — **accessibility/light-dark** — **high** — use `context.tokigoColors.onBrand`.
- `checkout_page.dart:582-608` — the selected tile paints border/radio in `brand` (neutral ink) and leaves the icon at `:588` in `textSecondary`; under the red-primary requirement the selected state must move to `primary` and the icon should follow the selected ink. — **color** — **med** — drive selected border/fill/check/icon from `primary`/`onPrimary`.
- `checkout_page.dart:647-698` — card fields use floating `labelText`/`hintText` with hardcoded English ('Card number', 'Name on card', 'Expiry', 'CVC', 'Required', '3 digits', 'Enter a valid card number'); no `l10n`, unlike every other funnel form. — **component/accessibility** — **high** — localize and align with the funnel's single field recipe.
- `checkout_page.dart:759` vs `:524` — the breakdown total uses `typography.title` (25/700) while the bar total uses `titleMedium` (22/800) → two price styles for the same amount. — **typography** — **med** — one price style per surface role.
- `checkout_page.dart:817-836` — the failure strip paints `danger` (#E11D48) on `dangerContainer` (#FCEAEF) at 13px = **4.06:1**, failing AA in light (dark 4.84 passes). — **accessibility/light-dark** — **high** — use a darker on-container step (or ≥4.5:1 pair) for the strip label.
- `checkout_page.dart:469-495` — the processing overlay dims only the scroll body; the CTA bar stays full-contrast while its button is disabled at 3.32:1, so the bar does not read as busy. — **state/accessibility** — **med** — dim the whole surface (or move progress into the bar) and fix the disabled pair (see A).
- `checkout_page.dart:332-336` — `_say` reports the blocking "no booking" state with a SnackBar, while payment failures use the inline strip → two feedback patterns for the same severity. — **state** — **low** — use the inline strip for blocking payment/booking states.
- `checkout_page.dart:466` vs `passenger_details_page.dart:203` — 160 vs 140 bottom spacer. — **spacing** — **low** — one shared clearance token.
- `checkout_page.dart:504-546` — the failure strip is prepended inside `bottomSheet`, so the bar shifts up when it appears (layout jump under the finger). — **spacing/state** — **low** — reserve the strip's height or overlay it.

## E. bag_page.dart (424)

- `bag_page.dart:304-307` — `StatusChip` is built from raw `tripStatusColor` with the default `color@10%` container and no dot; at the 11px label style the light pairs are success **2.96:1**, warning **2.86:1**, danger **4.00:1** → all fail AA. — **accessibility** — **high** — use `StatusChip.forTone` (or an on-container label colour) for trip status.
- `trip_labels.dart:48-55` — `tripStatusColor` returns static `AppColors.*` (light values) regardless of brightness; in dark the cancelled/failed chip is #E11D48 at 10% = **3.75:1** (fail) and the wrong token (dark danger is #F43F5E). — **light-dark/accessibility** — **high** — resolve status colours from `context.tokigoColors` (or pass the palette in).
- `bag_page.dart:287-301` — the vertical icon + label are painted in `brand`; under the red-primary requirement this is a "small badge" candidate for `primary`, and the icon duplicates the image fallback at `:272-278`. — **color/component** — **med** — drive the badge from `primary` and drop the duplicated glyph.
- `bag_page.dart:127-138` and `:148-161` — `SearchSegmentedControl` selected state is `brand`, and its row height is 36dp (< 48dp target). — **accessibility/component** — **med** — 48dp row; move selected to `primary` with the red pair.
- `bag_page.dart:267-279` — trip thumbnail is 56×56, vs 64×64 on the confirmation recap and 72×72 on trip details, for the same trip image. — **component** — **med** — one thumbnail size per surface role.
- `bag_page.dart:34-36` — the doc comment says the Cancelled filter is not built, but `:148-161` builds it. — **state** — **low** — correct the comment.

## F. trip_details_page.dart (374)

- `trip_details_page.dart:150-153` — same `StatusChip` AA failure as the Bag list (see E). — **accessibility** — **high** — `StatusChip.forTone`.
- `trip_details_page.dart:322-328` — the cancel entry is `AppButtonType.ghost` (neutral brand ink) while the comment at `:245` says "danger ghost button" and the dialog confirm at `:280` is `danger`; `AppButtonType.destructive` (`app_button.dart:21`) exists but is unused. — **component/state/color** — **high** — use the destructive treatment for the entry action and keep the primary red off destructive.
- `trip_details_page.dart:353-371` (label at `:361`) — fact labels use `caption` + `textTertiary` = **3.14:1** in light, failing AA. — **accessibility** — **high** — see A (`textTertiary`).
- `trip_details_page.dart:181-190` — the facts container uses `symmetric(horizontal: lg, vertical: xs)` while the header card above uses `all(lg)` → mismatched container padding on one page. — **spacing** — **low** — one container padding recipe.
- `trip_details_page.dart:113-125` — thumbnail 72×72 vs 56 (Bag) vs 64 (confirmation). — **component** — **med** — align thumbnail sizes.
- `trip_details_page.dart:264-285` — the dialog actions inherit `textButtonTheme` (brand foreground), not `colorScheme.primary`; when primary becomes red these buttons stay neutral unless the theme is updated — a spot the red migration will silently miss. — **color** — **med** — wire dialog action foregrounds to the same source as primary.
- `trip_details_page.dart:226-229` — the cancel action is inline at the end of a `ListView`, not pinned, so it can sit far from the facts it acts on. — **component** — **low** — pin it (or group it with the facts card).

## G. booking_confirmation_page.dart (603)

- `booking_confirmation_page.dart:419-427` — leftover sandbox copy ('Sandbox simulated booking — no real charge', 'Passenger: Test Guest (ADT) — simplified sandbox data'), unlocalized English, inserted between the date rows and the travellers row; it contradicts the page's real-booking rule and breaks the fact-row rhythm. — **state/component** — **high** — delete or replace with real recap rows.
- `booking_confirmation_page.dart:427` — raw `TextStyle(fontSize: 12, …)` bypasses the type scale. — **typography** — **med** — use `typography.caption`/`body`.
- `booking_confirmation_page.dart:551-563` — `_CopyReferenceButton` is 40×40 → below the 48dp minimum touch target. — **accessibility** — **high** — 48×48 (keep the visible glyph at 18–20).
- `booking_confirmation_page.dart:122-134` and `:243-265` — bottom padding uses `MediaQuery.of(context).padding.bottom`, while `StickyCtaBar` deliberately uses `viewPaddingOf` (`sticky_cta_bar.dart:34`); on edge-to-edge the buttons can land under the navigation bar. — **accessibility/spacing** — **med** — use `viewPaddingOf` (or a pinned bar).
- `booking_confirmation_page.dart:198-204` + `:281-285` — `_CheckPainter` hardcodes `AppColors.success` (#16A34A) with no context: light **2.94:1** on `successContainer` (just under the 3:1 graphics bar) and dark draws the light green instead of `tokigoColors.success` (#22C55E). — **color/light-dark** — **med** — pass the theme success colour into the painter.
- `booking_confirmation_page.dart:392` and `:454` — `textTertiary` captions fail AA in light (see A). — **accessibility** — **high** — see A.
- `booking_confirmation_page.dart:443` — `Divider(height: 1, thickness: 1, color: outline)` vs checkout's theme `Divider` (`checkout_page.dart:746`) → two divider recipes. — **component** — **low** — one divider token.
- `booking_confirmation_page.dart:164` — the header has no `subtitle`, so `AppPageHeader` renders no `Semantics.header` and the page is unnamed to assistive tech. — **accessibility** — **low** — pass a localized subtitle (or an explicit header semantics).
- `booking_confirmation_page.dart:149` — currency falls back to a hardcoded `'USD'` while checkout resolves `checkoutCurrencyProvider`. — **state** — **low** — one currency source.

## H. add_ons_page.dart (108)

- `add_ons_page.dart:66` — default `light` `StickyCtaBar` (blur 16) instead of the charcoal component. — **component/color** — **high** — charcoal variant.
- `add_ons_page.dart:91-101` — bar CTA is `AppButton` primary (brand fill), not the inverted white charcoal button. — **component/color** — **high** — decide the bar treatment (see A).
- `add_ons_page.dart:79-86` — the bar total shows `basePrice` (add-ons excluded) while checkout shows provider + add-ons; the "real total" contract differs per step. — **state/component** — **med** — state the same total basis on every funnel step.
- `add_ons_page.dart:53-61` — `AppMessageState` sits in a bare `SingleChildScrollView`, giving a 24dp gutter vs the funnel's 16dp page gutter. — **spacing** — **low** — align the empty state to the page gutter.

## I. trip_labels.dart (66)

- `trip_labels.dart:48-55` — static `AppColors` status hues (see E): wrong token in dark and AA failures. — **light-dark/accessibility** — **high** — resolve from the theme palette.
- `trip_labels.dart:14-34` vs `booking_confirmation_page.dart:492-499` and `:483-490` — `tripTypeIcon`/`tripTypeLabel` are duplicated by the confirmation page's private `_typeIcon`/`_dateLabels`, so the same vertical/date labels have two vocabularies. — **component** — **med** — have the confirmation recap call `trip_labels.dart`.

## J. Already consistent (no action)

- Monochrome surfaces, 1px `outline` card borders, `lg`(18) card radius with `sm`(10) thumbnails, and `md`(14) button radius are applied uniformly across the audited pages; no gradients are used.
- The 8dp spacing scale is used correctly almost everywhere; the only off-scale values are the 160/140 list spacers, the 104dp country-code field and the 40dp copy button.
- `AppButton`'s 52dp height, press scale and haptics are consistent wherever it is used; the breakdown is that the Bag/Trip pages and the hotel page do not use it for their primary actions.
